title: Reference measurement record (contracts v1)
description: One attested component's reference measurement as the pipeline hands it to the TRAIN publication step (scripts/train-publish). The value is the CMC container measurement of the component as deployed, the template hash over the normalised OCI configuration and the rootfs (ADR-0011, 4.1), never the image digest; the image digest travels beside it so a reader can tie the entry to the image that is running. Produced by the measurement step, consumed by the publisher; neither computes what the other owns.

component.description: The attested component, as the charts name it.

zone.description: The zone the component is deployed in. With the component it fixes the entry's UUID.

serviceTypeIdentifier.description: The string the verifying connector asks the TCR for; written into the entry's ServiceTypeIdentifier, the trust-list lookup key (ADR-0011, 4.3).

image.description: The image the measurement was taken for, by digest. A tag is not accepted: the digest is what admission admits and what the running pod reports.

type.description: The algorithm lives in the type, never in the value (ADR-0011, 4.2). A new algorithm is a new type.

value.description: The template hash: sha256(normalised OCI config || rootfs hash), lowercase hex, no prefix.

configSha256.description: The two halves the template hash is built from, for the record; the value above is what is published.

commit.description: The repository commit the measured configuration comes from.

tool.description: The measuring code and its revision, so two values are only compared when both sides ran the same one.
